tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations support positive gain but cannot distinguish the dual-horizon adaptation law’s long-horizon behavior. The recalled verified mechanism specifically recommends the slow-horizon probe first; its cost is justified by the large target forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law using the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations use short horizons (H ≤ 0.48); the slow adaptation component is not identifiable well enough to forecast to H=22.4.
A long-horizon discriminating probe is a more direct, lower-cost way to resolve the competing slow-adaptation behavior.
It is irrelevant to the stated candidate mechanism and should not be purchased.
